note_text:
CC: diabetic foot evaluation with new dorsal swelling

HPI: 6 months of symptoms relating to thickened painful nails. Patient also reports a distinct symptom requiring separate evaluation. Peripheral vascular disease noted.

Exam: nails examined consistent with thickened painful nails; no other findings recorded.

MDM: addressed an independent problem with risks, data review (X-ray pending), and a management plan distinct from the procedure decision; shared decision making documented.

Procedure: Debridement of 1 to 5 thickened nails performed with sterile technique (LT and RT modifiers documented). Tolerated well, no immediate complications.

(End of note.)
